reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the protein variant stability batch for use-case-protein-stability: 651 records (427 results, 120 evaluations, 42 configurations, 23 methods, 12 datasets, 12 protocols, 12 relevance judgements, 3 sources). Every result checked against Pancotti et al. 2022 Table 1, Dieckhaus et al. 2024 Tables 2 and 3 and Chu et al. 2024 Table 1. See docs/reviews/use-cases/protein-variant-stability-2026-10-09.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any predictor.
Supplementary materials of the three papers were not read; Pancotti predictor versions remain unextracted.
Compiled Dieckhaus Table 3 values for Ssym were not checked against their original papers; the S669 values were checked against Pancotti et al. 2022.
Relevance judgement pins are left unset for the integrator; all 15 judgements on the use case were simulated active after re-pinning, with the approved use-case text applied in memory.

The collector reports that rerunning extract/extract_protein_stability.py on the archived artifacts reproduced the pre-review batch.jsonl and claims.csv byte for byte. That was not relied on; every cell was checked independently. After this review's edits the script no longer reproduces batch.jsonl or claims.csv.

errors.message: Compiled ACDC-NN S669 RMSE 1.60 disagrees with the cited source (Pancotti et al. 2022 Table 1: 1.49 direct; 1.60 is DDGun3D's value). Set to disputed with source_warnings; the Pancotti value stays source_checked.
Origin corrected to author_reported: Pancotti authors Fariselli and Capriotti co-developed INPS-MD and I-Mutant.
Origin corrected to independent_paper; ProteinMPNN was not developed by the Dieckhaus authors.

Eight evaluations excluded with reasons: six homologue-inflated Fireprot rows (Table 2 *), ABYSSAL on 420 filtered S669 variants (Table 3 dagger), ESM therm on the mega-scale set (scored on multi-point variants as well).
metric_direction set to lower (perfect antisymmetry is -1).

record_ids: Dieckhaus Fireprot protocol, dataset and judgement
errors.message: Wrong or copied limitation and rationale text corrected; Chu text-table conflicts recorded; label spacing cleaned.
Approved use-case text changes pinned fields; the three existing judgements hold but must be re-pinned with the twelve new ones.
